decisions.reason: As a core LED track spotlight closely aligned with the firm's established lighting systems and still prominently presented a year after launch, it fits existing knowledge and is likely worth refining rather than withdrawing.
The LED ceiling luminaire is close to the firm's core offer and remained on its own page through 2024, suggesting enough strategic fit and learning potential to keep it in the range.

This flexible LED spotlight is highly related to the firm's existing competencies and, as a new 2024 launch with full presentation, management would usually allow more time to absorb market feedback and improve it.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy builds directly on the firm's modular system knowledge and likely strengthens system sales, so it is more likely to be retained and iterated than dropped quickly.

The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy is a related line extension that uses existing technical and commercial capabilities, making continued development more plausible than early exit despite its narrower application.

Although the round glass track luminaires are close to the firm's offer, their weaker website presence in 2024 implies a less proven position, so they face a materially higher withdrawal risk but are still more likely than not to be kept while the firm tests demand.
